page.layout: One printed page, a title page: all lines centred in one block, no margins. Handwritten "29." at top right is not printed and is left out.

main_text.l: quibus Missae sacrificium exstruere nititur, vindicata,
& ad disputandum proposita in schola Tig.

page.notes: The page carries no running head, page number or signature. Long s is rendered as plain s; the printed "f" forms in "exstruere", "fubstinente" and similar are read as long s. The line "Die Synodum Maji..." ends with a printed mark after "insequente," that is read as a comma-like sign. Some letters in the Hebrew-free title are faded but legible.
